text: ALL DONE -- GitHub Project board populated

text.text:
*Everything is now in place:*
• Plan delivered to this Slack channel (4 messages)
• 16 labels, 7 milestones, *47 issues* (#18..#64) in `DimonBel/Document-editor`
• *GitHub Project #6* created: <https://github.com/DimonBel/Document-editor/projects/6|open the board>
• 4 custom fields added to the project:
  - *Status* -- Backlog, Todo, In Progress, In Review, Blocked, Done
  - *Track* -- Foundations, Infra, Gateway, Backend/room, Backend/doc, Backend/latex, E2E
  - *Priority* -- P0, P1, P2, P3
  - *Estimate* -- S, M, L, XL
• All 47 issues added to the board, defaulted to *Backlog* with Track/Priority/Estimate auto-set from the labels

*Stats:*
```
M0 Foundations (10)  -  9x P0  +  1x P1
M1 Containers  (7)   -  4x P0  +  2x P1  +  1x P3
M2 Gateway    (9)    -  4x P0  +  4x P1  +  1x P2
M3 room       (6)    -  4x P0  +  2x P1
M4 doc        (6)    -  5x P0  +  1x P2
M5 latex      (6)    -  4x P0  +  2x P1
M6 E2E        (3)    -  3x P0
```

*What's next?*
• Open <https://github.com/DimonBel/Document-editor/projects/6|the project board> and start a Table view grouped by Milestone
• Suggested views: *By Milestone*, *Critical Path* (filter `Status != Done AND Priority in (P0, P1)`), *By Track* (Roadmap layout)
• When you start a refactor branch (`refactor/<scope>`), update the issue's Status to `In Progress` and the assignee to yourself
• Each PR that closes an issue will auto-move the Status to *Done* via GitHub's built-in automation

*Artifacts left in the repo under `.issues/`*
• `create_issues.py` (idempotent — already ran; don't re-run unless intentional)
• `setup_project.py` (idempotent — safe to re-run for a refresh)
• `issue-01.md` ... `issue-47.md` (every body, plain Markdown, reviewable)
• `slack-msg-1.json` ... `slack-msg-3.json` + `slack-update.json` (raw payloads sent)

You can `git clean -fd .issues/` whenever you want the working tree tidy.
